set.body: From S4.5d (p0-s45d). ResultSummary.grandDByScale has no StudioRef (a whole-report cell's ref is None), so the scale profile cannot draw the Results board's all-participants grand mean and draws the two group means instead. Give the whole-report cell a ref and draw the grand mean as the board specifies.
set.title: StudioRef for the whole-report grand-mean cell (grandDByScale)
